plm.msg.pom_required: A point of measure is required.

qc.badge.std: ANSI/ASQ Z1.4 · level II · single · normal
qc.hint.pareto: 80% of trouble sits at the top
qc.hint.verdict: The verdict is computed from the sampling plan — accept at or below Ac, reject at Re. It cannot be typed in.
qc.hint.defects: Defect quantity is not defective units — one unit can carry several defects.
qc.empty.inspections: No inspections yet — record the first one.

trc.lots.sub: Each lot points at the lot it was made from. That single link is what turns a fabric roll into a fibre-to-product chain.

trc.esg.sub: Energy, water and waste as recorded per order or per month, divided by pieces produced.
trc.passport.title: Digital Product Passport
trc.dash.tier_note: Traceability depth is how far upstream the chain actually reaches — tier 4 is the fibre itself.
trc.lot.no_upstream: No upstream lot recorded — traceability stops at this supplier.
trc.dpp.lots_linked: A material lot is linked to the order
trc.dpp.composition: Every lot in the chain states its fibre composition
trc.dpp.supplier: Every lot in the chain names its supplier
trc.dpp.tier3: A tier-3 spinner / dyehouse is named in the chain
trc.dpp.certificates: A valid material certificate covers the chain
trc.dpp.footprint: An ESG footprint is recorded for the order
trc.empty.watch: No material certificate is close to expiry.
trc.empty.passports: No live orders to assess yet.
trc.empty.chain: No material lot is linked to this order yet — the passport cannot be traced.
trc.empty.chain_certs: No material certificate covers this chain.
trc.warn.truncated: The upstream walk was stopped early — this chain loops back on itself or is longer than the safety limit. Fix the parent lot links.
trc.note.register: Live orders by ship date, soonest first. Orders with no ship date come last.
trc.esg.disclaimer: Recorded metered/invoiced data divided by pieces produced. This is not a certified LCA or a verified carbon footprint.

pln.board.hint: Loaded minutes ÷ available minutes. Over 100% = the line is promised more than it has.
pln.board.title: Load board — lines × days

pln.empty.ops: No operations yet — add the operation bulletin to balance this line.

pln.err.no_capacity: That line has no capacity (check operators, minutes and efficiency).

pln.title: Production planning

cst.bom.formula: Required qty = order qty × consumption per unit × (1 + allowance %). The allowance is cutting and process wastage, so it increases the buy.
cst.dash.sub: Every order costed once and reconciled to what it actually cost — before the margin is gone.
cst.empty.bom: No BOM yet — add the fabric and trims that go into one garment.
cst.empty.costed: No order has a BOM or cost sheet yet — open an order to build one.
cst.empty.prs: No purchase requisition linked to this order yet.
cst.field.cm_flat: Flat CM per unit (used when SMV × rate is not set)
cst.filter.costed_only: Only orders with a BOM or cost sheet
cst.orders.sub: Quoted margin against delivered margin, order by order.
cst.sources.mixed: Linked PRs in another currency are shown below but not added — there is no order-currency rate to convert them.
cst.sources.note: Material bought on a linked purchase requisition and then issued from the warehouse is one cost, not two. The actual is taken from a single source: warehouse issues first, then procurement receipts, then manual entries.
cst.warn.overrun: This order is running over its estimate — the quoted margin is not what will be delivered.
cst.warn.unpriced: BOM lines have no unit price — those estimates are incomplete and understate the cost.
cut.dash.sub: Marker efficiency, fabric utilisation and cut-vs-order reconciliation — fabric is 60–70% of garment cost, so this is where the margin is won or lost.
cut.empty.orders: No lays recorded yet — record the first lay to start measuring fabric.
cut.hint.no_plan: No metre-denominated fabric line on this order's BOM, so no planned consumption to compare against.
cut.hint.readonly: You have read-only access to the cut room.
cut.empty.rolls: No rolls booked to this lay yet.
cut.hint.rolls: Booking a roll here records traceability and shade-lot control only — stock is issued in the warehouse.
cut.form.sub: Enter the marker and the spread — pieces, consumption, marker efficiency and utilisation are calculated as you type.
cut.lays.sub: Every spread with its marker, plies, size ratio and what it really cost in fabric.
cut.order.sub: cut quantity and fabric variance against plan
cut.hint.overcut: More pieces cut than ordered — over-cut fabric is paid for and rarely shipped.
ppl.att.sub: Mark the whole day in one pass. Re-posting a day corrects it — it never duplicates.
ppl.dash.sub: Attendance, leave, the skill matrix that drives line allocation, and earned-minute incentive — one view.
ppl.empty.balances: No balances yet — they are created on the first request.
ppl.empty.best: Nobody is rated at level 2 or above on this operation yet.
ppl.empty.incentive: No production recorded in this range.
ppl.empty.matrix: No ratings yet — rate an operator above.
ppl.empty.roster: No employees on the roster yet.
ppl.inc.formula: Earned minutes = pieces × SMV. Efficiency = earned ÷ worked. Incentive = (earned − threshold minutes) × rate, never below zero.
ppl.inc.sub: Earned-minute model: only minutes produced above the qualifying efficiency are paid.
ppl.leave.rule: Unpaid leave carries no entitlement and is not balance-checked.
ppl.leave.sub: A request can never exceed the remaining balance, and approving deducts it exactly once.
ppl.skills.legend: Level 1 trainee · 2 assisted · 3 standard · 4 fast · 5 trainer. Only level 2 and above are proposed for allocation.
ppl.skills.sub: Who can run which operation, and how well — the input to skill-based line allocation.
shp.dash.sub: What actually left the factory — cartons, packing lists, commercial invoices and ordered-vs-shipped.
shp.list.sub: Every export shipment with its cartons, volume and documents.
shp.recon.sub: Ordered against packed and shipped. Short and over shipments are both buyer chargebacks — they are flagged here and on the bell.
shp.recon.title: Fulfilment by order
shp.detail.lock_note: Once the status is dispatched or delivered the packing list is final and can no longer be edited.
shp.detail.carton_note: Weights and dimensions are per carton. CBM = L x W x H in metres, times the number of cartons.

shp.detail.no_rights: You do not have permission to edit this packing list.
shp.doc.declare: We certify that the above information is true and correct.
shp.doc.note: Weights and dimensions are per carton; totals are per line.
shp.form.sub: Pick the order — buyer, currency and the invoice unit price are copied from it and frozen on this shipment.

shp.empty.recon: Every order is shipping within tolerance.
shp.empty.cartons: No carton lines yet — add the first one.
shp.empty.invoice: Nothing packed yet — the invoice has no value lines.
wh.dash.sub: Every fabric roll, trim and packed carton — with the dye lot, the metres left and the order it was cut for.
wh.empty.fg: Nothing packed yet for this filter.
wh.empty.low: Every material is above its reorder level.
wh.empty.materials: No materials yet — add the first one below.
wh.empty.orders: No live customer order to issue against.
wh.empty.plan: Nothing available for this material — receive stock or raise a purchase requisition.
wh.fg.legend: Each cell shows what is in store, then packed / shipped underneath.
wh.fg.sub: Packed and shipped by style, colour and size — the matrix a garment order actually ships in.
wh.field.name: Name
wh.field.rolltracked: Roll-tracked (fabric / tape — stock is held as individual rolls)
wh.issue.mixed: No single dye lot covers this quantity — the pick mixes lots.
wh.issue.qty_material: Quantity-tracked material — issued straight from the quantity on hand, there are no rolls to pick.
wh.issue.short_warn: Not enough material — nothing will be issued until the gap is covered.
wh.issue.sub: Oldest rolls first, kept to one dye lot where the requirement allows — mixed shade in one lay is a rejected shipment.
wh.issue.title: Issue material to an order
wh.mat.sub: Fabric, trims and accessories with on-hand, reserved and reorder levels.
wh.recv.sub: Book a delivery in. Roll-tracked materials create one roll per receipt; trims are added to the quantity on hand.
wh.rolls.sub: Each roll with its dye lot, width and the metres actually left on it.
wsh.batches.hint: Actuals outside tolerance are flagged and raise a bell alert.
wsh.batches.sub: Every lot records the exact recipe version it ran — that is what makes the shade reproducible later.
wsh.batches.title: Wash batches
wsh.dash.sub: Versioned wash recipes, chemical dosing and batch traceability — so a shade can be reproduced months later.
wsh.dash.title: Wash recipe library
wsh.detail.frozen: This version is frozen. Create a new version to change the steps — batches already reference this one.
wsh.detail.gate: A version can only be approved for bulk once one of its own lab dips is approved. Approving it retires the previous bulk standard.
wsh.detail.impact_note: Internal indicator only — not a certified EIM score. Water, energy and chemical intensity per kg of goods, each capped at 100 and averaged. Lower is better.
wsh.dips.sub: A recipe version cannot go to bulk until one of its own lab dips is approved.
